versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Multi-agent cross-checking" section outlining scheduled mutual verification between agents to ensure all mirrors are up to date and consistent.
- Clarified the protocol for mutual checks, receipt loops, and how to handle stale mirrors in multi-agent setups.
- No changes to protocol logic or other sections beyond documentation update.

- Initial release of the memory-system protocol for long-running AI agents.
- Provides dual daily logs: concise summary and exact verbatim transcripts.
- Includes encoding safety rules to prevent data corruption from mixed environments.
- Supports automated backup, sync, and checksum verification for log reliability.
- Optional multi-agent shared-facts synchronization and knowledge base structure.
- Detailed startup, periodic check routines, and agent sensory/feeling state integration.
